Foreign tourist arrivals to India shrank. Domestic travel went from 232 crore trips in 2019 to 413 crore in 2025. India built one of the world's largest travel markets by selling to itself, and almost nobody noticed it happening.
This is a breakdown of How India Travels 2025, the report Booking.com put together with Accenture and the Ministry of Tourism. It draws on roughly 14 crore monthly searches, a survey of over 3,000 travellers across Tier I, II and III cities, interviews with Marriott, Hyatt, Brij and The Postcard, lodging data from Hotelivate and investment data from JLL.
